limitations: Frequencies describe the stated factor distributions, not the probability of any outcome in the world; no distribution is inferred from evidence or ranges.
Distinct factors are independent unless a quantile group states perfectly shared quantiles; no correlation coefficient, covariance or copula is supported.
Preflight intervals are conservative and not outward-rounded: a support that could reach a zero denominator or a negative ratio target is refused even at probability zero.
Only explicitly required quantities and quantile-group members are run; original drafts and omitted IDs remain retained.
Quantity-check preflight uses conservative support enclosures; a reused-factor image may fit when its enclosure does not.
No bounds are inferred from a unit, source classification or template name.

range.interpretation: Conservative support enclosure, not proven extrema or a confidence interval.
